title: Basic calculator
instruction: Compute and print the result of: add 15 and 23, then multiply the result by 3. Use a single expression and parentheses.

title: Print a calculation result
instruction: Print the result of **42 - 17** directly inside `print()`. Let Python do the math.

title: Area of a circle
instruction: Calculate the area of a circle with radius 7. Use the formula area = π * r². Use 3.14159 for π. Print the result rounded naturally (Python will show the float).

title: Mix text and an expression
instruction: Print the string **Twelve squared is** followed by the expression **12 ** 2** (no quotes on the expression) — both in one `print()`, separated by a comma.
